checks_performed.check: R11: Dimensional analysis of 1852 defect fix (§2.3)

checks_performed.result: PASS — Original denominator capacity·V_ref[m/s]·3600 = capacity·V_ref[m/h]; correct denominator capacity·V_ref[kn] = capacity·V_ref[nm/h]. Since 1 nm = 1852 m, the original denominator was 1852× too large, making EEXI 1852× too small. The fix is dimensionally correct.

findings.title: Jansen estimator 'S_i ≥ 0' claim is wrong for first-order estimates
findings.description: §2.2 states the Jansen estimator '同样满足 S_i ≥ 0', but Table 5 prints 6 negative first-order indices. All are within ±1 SE (estimator noise), so no conclusion changes, but the method description is factually incorrect. Jansen's first-order estimator is not mathematically non-negative; only the total-effect form is.
findings.impact: If downstream users quote this as a method property, they will be misinformed. No effect on this report's numerical conclusions.
findings.remediation: Change prose to '总效应估计量非负' or '一阶估计量在噪声水平内可正可负'.
findings.upstream_status: Already identified as X4 in wp-11421-01 crosscheck.

findings.title: FD vs analytic '<5%' claim violated by geom_L
findings.description: §3.4(b) claims '非零项相对差 < 5%', but geom_L has 16.25% relative difference (analytic=0.00080, FD=0.00067). The report itself explains this is at the Holtrop quantization floor (§4.1), so the defect is the unconditional wording, not the numbers.
findings.impact: Minor — the numbers are correct, only the summary statement is overbroad.
findings.remediation: Add qualifier: '|c_i| ≥ 0.005 的项相对差 < 5%' or exclude geom_L from the claim.
findings.upstream_status: Already identified as X5 in wp-11421-01 crosscheck.

findings.title: EEXI interaction effects not discussed
findings.description: ΣS_T,g(EEXI) - ΣS_g(EEXI) = 0.0146, meaning ~1.5% of EEXI variance comes from factor interactions. For CII it's only 0.3%. This difference is physically meaningful (EEXI's V_ref反解 introduces nonlinearity that CII's direct evaluation lacks), but the report does not discuss it.
findings.impact: None on correctness; missed opportunity for physical insight.
findings.remediation: Add a sentence in §3.3 noting the interaction difference and its physical origin.

findings.title: 'Holtrop-Mennen 唯一实现' not independently verifiable from this record
findings.description: The report claims Holtrop-Mennen is the '唯一实现' (only implementation) in backend/physics/holtrop. This is a claim about the codebase, not about the report's internal consistency. From this record alone, it cannot be verified — it's a referenced_unresolved asset (A11).
findings.impact: None on this report's numerical results. Relevant only if downstream users need to know about alternative implementations.
findings.remediation: No action needed for this report; the asset is correctly classified as referenced_unresolved in wp-11421-01.

findings.title: Table 6 σ→0 ratios computed from internal values, not printed σ
findings.description: The ratio column in Table 6 (σ(ε)/σ(1)) and the relative error column are computed from internal high-precision σ values, not from the 4-decimal printed σ values. A reader recomputing from the table will get different ratios (e.g., ε=0.001: printed ratio=0.00129 vs reported 0.00100). This is not a defect but a clarity issue.

evidence.note: The crosscheck X6 correctly identifies this as 'within quantum'.

findings.impact: None on correctness; may confuse readers who try to reproduce from printed values.
findings.remediation: Add a footnote: '比值由内部高精度 σ 计算，非由表中四舍五入值重算'.

disposition_rationale: The report is internally consistent on all verifiable arithmetic claims. The two findings (F1, F2) are already identified by the upstream wp-11421-01 crosscheck as X4 and X5 — both are low-severity prose/documentation issues, not numerical errors. The report's numerical results (MC distributions, Sobol indices, convergence, negative controls) are self-consistent and physically plausible. The remaining findings (F3–F5) are informational: missing interpretation, unverifiable external claims, and documentation clarity. None block acceptance of the report's scientific content.
remediation_summary: Fix F1 (prose about Jansen estimator non-negativity) and F2 (5% bound qualifier). Consider adding F3 (interaction effects discussion) and F5 (Table 6 footnote) for clarity. No numerical corrections needed.

X4.note: Confirmed: 6 negative S_i entries, all within ±1 SE. Prose claim is wrong.

X5.note: Confirmed: geom_L rel_diff=16.25% > 5%. Wording issue, not numerical.
